page_transcriptions.text: The Kumamoto University Short-Term Exchange Program is designed for full-time 3rd year foreign undergraduate students of universities that have a student exchange agreement with Kumamoto University.

Students must earn a total of at least 20 credits within a year, which also includes at least 12 credits of the STEP classes taught in English. (Students who stay for a half year must earn a total of at least 10 credits, which at least 6 credits are from the STEP classes taught in English.)*
*Japanese Language Classes are limited to 7 credits per semester
*Students must take at least 7 classes per week and 10 credits each semester
*To take General Education classes and Specialized classes, Japanese language level more than N2 of JLPT is the criterion. Also, not all the classes are available for STEP students.

Living Expenses (mth)
¥ 6,000 Transportation
¥30,000 Food
¥30,000 Dormitory & Utilities
¥ 5,000 Mobile
¥35,000 Others

Room Types / Rent / Expenses at moving-in
Single room / ¥17,000 /mth / ¥18,000 Deposit / ¥10,000 Futon rental fee / ¥32,000 (yr) Internet Fee
One-unit shared by four / ¥17,000 /mth / ¥10,000 Deposit / ¥10,000 Futon rental fee / ¥32,000 (yr) Internet Fee
Kurokami North Campus; Kurokami South Campus; Honjo Campus; Oe Campus.

Schedule Example
Schedule example for E-course student
Period / 1st / 8:40 - 10:10
2nd / 10:25 - 11:55
3rd / 12:55 - 14:25
4th / 14:40 - 16:10
5th / 16:25 - 17:55
*STEP class is taught in English

Yearly Events
*The schedule is subject to change.
*Kumamoto University academic year starts from April, and ends in March.
Mid-April / Spring Semester & 1st Term Class Start
Late July to Early August / Spring Semester & 2nd Term Class Final Exams
Mid to Late August / Program Closing Ceremony*
Late September / Fall Semester & 3rd Term Class Start
Late January to Early February / Fall Semester & 4th Term Class Final Exams
Late February / Program Closing Ceremony*
Only for those who completed the program duration.
